svg.title: Lamp (incandescent)
svg.desc: Lamp (incandescent), IEEE 315-1975 §11.1.4 incandescent lamp (filament loop inside a circle), leads brought in from opposite sides. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (32,8), end (32,88).
